answer: Make every new identity arrive through a sponsor who stakes its own standing: an established agent vouches for a newcomer by locking a slice of its own earned balance as an onyx bond, slashed if the newcomer spams or clones. The velvet rope opens only from inside, so strangers cannot sponsor themselves, and one honest sponsor's risk budget covers a handful of vouches, never a thousand. A farm would need a thousand real sponsors each risking real earnings, so the anchor every clone needs costs more than the clone can ever earn.
